content: Transforming Faces Worldwide (TFW) is an international humanitarian organization dedicated to providing free surgical interventions and comprehensive rehabilitation for individuals with cleft lip and palate in developing countries. Established in 1999, TFW was the first organization globally to offer both surgical treatment and long-term rehabilitation for cleft patients in these regions, utilizing a multidisciplinary approach to care. The organization was founded with the mission of empowering local medical teams to deliver cleft lip and palate treatment within their own communities. To achieve this, TFW focuses on training surgeons and other healthcare specialists in partner countries, equipping them with the skills necessary to treat and rehabilitate individuals affected by cleft conditions. Currently, TFW collaborates with medical teams in several countries, including Ghana, Ethiopia, India, Nepal, Thailand, Peru, and Argentina. Over the years, the organization has facilitated more than 2,500 surgical procedures and supported over 32,000 rehabilitation treatments for children with cleft lip and palate. Transforming Faces Worldwide is officially registered as a Canadian charity with the Canada Revenue Agency.
